title: Lock & login screens: Turn off multi-state blur/darkening when using a solid color
line: A plain color lock or login screen wallpaper now keeps its color instead of turning darker when the password prompt appears.
explanation: The lock screen (plasma-desktop LockScreenUi.qml) and Plasma Login Manager's wallpaper window put a WallpaperFader over every wallpaper, which blurs, lowers contrast, raises saturation and darkens it when the prompt is shown. On a plain color the blur does nothing and the rest turns the color into a different, darker shade (61,174,233 became 26,121,170 on the rig). Both now hide the fader when the wallpaper plugin is org.kde.color, the same way the SDDM Breeze theme already hides it for non-image backgrounds; the fader's states still drive the prompt, footer and clock fades.

commits.message:
lockscreen: don't blur and darken a plain color wallpaper

The lock screen ran its blur and darkening effect on every wallpaper, so
a plain color one just turned into a warped, darker shade whenever the
prompt showed up. Skip the effect for it, as the SDDM theme does too.

BUG: 395534

wallpaper: don't blur and darken a plain color wallpaper

The login screen ran its blur and darkening effect on every wallpaper,
so a plain color one just turned into a warped, darker shade behind the
login prompt. Skip the effect for it, as the SDDM theme already does.

BUG: 395534

From 0afe1ee0feedf2da589439c22b20cc8fe42f310b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 20:03:12 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lockscreen: don't blur and darken a plain color wallpaper

The lock screen ran its blur and darkening effect on every wallpaper, so
a plain color one just turned into a warped, darker shade whenever the
prompt showed up. Skip the effect for it, as the SDDM theme does too.

BUG: 395534
---
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
index 065a33c131..9cd5eab0a9 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
@@ -236,6 +236,7 @@ Item {
 
         WallpaperFader {
             anchors.fill: parent
+            visible: wallpaper?.pluginName !== "org.kde.color"
             state: lockScreenRoot.uiVisible ? "on" : "off"
             mainStack: mainStack
             footer: footer
--

From 9efc793fd2d8e4d2798633f1b3d1f7aa939b085c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 20:03:12 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wallpaper: don't blur and darken a plain color wallpaper

The login screen ran its blur and darkening effect on every wallpaper,
so a plain color one just turned into a warped, darker shade behind the
login prompt. Skip the effect for it, as the SDDM theme already does.

BUG: 395534
---
 src/frontend/wallpaper/main.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/src/frontend/wallpaper/main.qml b/src/frontend/wallpaper/main.qml
index 2b807d72..c0f9d49c 100644
--- a/src/frontend/wallpaper/main.qml
+++ b/src/frontend/wallpaper/main.qml
@@ -28,6 +28,7 @@ Item {
 
     PlasmaLoginWallpaper.WallpaperFader {
         anchors.fill: parent
+        visible: source?.pluginName !== "org.kde.color"
         factor: Window.window?.blur ? 1 : 0
         source: wallpaperPlaceholder.children[0]
     }
--

review.text: Hiding WallpaperFader when the wallpaper plugin is org.kde.color in both plasma-desktop's LockScreenUi.qml and plasma-login-manager's wallpaper main.qml cleanly eliminates the unwanted darkening and color shift on solid-color backgrounds while matching the existing SDDM Breeze theme behavior. Using optional chaining safely handles initialization order, WallpaperFader states continue driving the lock screen UI fade animations, and image wallpapers retain their blur and darkening effect.

reviews.text: Hiding WallpaperFader when the wallpaper plugin is org.kde.color in both plasma-desktop's LockScreenUi.qml and plasma-login-manager's wallpaper main.qml cleanly eliminates the unwanted darkening and color shift on solid-color backgrounds while matching the existing SDDM Breeze theme behavior. Using optional chaining safely handles initialization order, WallpaperFader states continue driving the lock screen UI fade animations, and image wallpapers retain their blur and darkening effect.

This matches the current title exactly: no blur or darkening on plain-color lock and login screens. It reuses the precedent already in sddm-theme/Main.qml (fader shown only for image backgrounds). Hiding the WallpaperFader leaves its states, which still drive the prompt, footer and clock fades. FastBlur's hideSource follows visibility, so the real wallpaper shows through; the pixel measurements before and after prove this on both the lock screen and the login screen. pluginName is set by both greeters (kscreenlocker greeterapp and plasma-login-manager wallpaperapp), and image wallpapers were re-checked.
